name: Himal Traders SOC Lab - Detection Coverage
description: Detection & prevention coverage for the Himal Traders SOC Detection Lab: 7 Wazuh detections across 3 hosts and 4 telemetry sources, plus a Suricata IPS. Each highlighted technique's comment names the rule(s) that cover it. Load at https://mitre-attack.github.io/attack-navigator/ (Open Existing Layer -> Upload).

techniques.comment: PREVENTED - Suricata IPS drops SQLi inline (rules 1000010/1000011)
Wazuh 100003 - Office app spawns a shell (Sysmon EID 1)
Wazuh 100003 - PowerShell child of Office (Sysmon EID 1)
Wazuh 100012 - web shell dropped in web root (FIM)
Wazuh 100004/100008 - LSASS credential theft blocked by Defender (1116/1117)
Wazuh 100011 - shadow copy / backup deletion (Sysmon EID 1)
